title: Reflection Probe for Mobile and Forward+ crashes in Godot 4 Depending on Configuration
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.stable, 4.7.dev1, 4.6.3.stable, 4.6.2.stable, 4.6.1.stable, 4.6.stable, 4.5.stable, 4.4.1.stable, 4.4.stable, 4.0.stable, 4.0.beta1, 4.0.alpha15 *
- Not reproducible in: ~~4.6.3.stable~~

For the alpha version 15, I had to modify the **MRP**'s code ```change_scene_to_file``` to ```change_scene``` to get it to run.

Edit: I might upgrade this list through edits as I use the **MRP** to find the bug. I thought that 4.6.3.stable did not have a bug initially.

### System information

Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS - Godot v4.7.0.stable - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER

### Issue description

### What does not work
When the renderers are Forward+ or Mobile and the project setting "reflections/sky_reflections/roughness_layers" is set to 1 then it causes an instant crash.

### Crashing in Game
If you are running it in game and you so much as to load a scene with a reflection probe the game would instantly crash and exit.

### Crashing in Editor
Then Godot 4, the editor, would also quit with the same error.

### How I Found This Issue.
While upgrading from Godot 4.6.3 to Godot 4.7.0.stable, while entering a new level my project had instantly crashed. So I investigated and found out that a lack of a reflection probe caused the level to load perfectly. So I created a minimal testing suite and found that the reflection probe worked. So, I copied my project settings, and the bug happened again. So, I edited down the project.godot until it isolated that the roughness_layers value was causing this issue.

### Steps to reproduce

### With the MRP.
* In editor: You could just open up the "do_not_open.tscn", and the editor will crash and quit.
* In game: Run the game and press the center button, and the game would crash instantly.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This is my minimal reproduction project. It has two scene files named "main.tscn" and "do_not_open.tscn". "do_not_open.tscn" holds a scene with a reflection probe along with a sky, a light, a 3d label. They are created to make sure that the reflection probe works. "main.tscn" is the main scene of the project. It holds the button which would change the scene to "do_not_open.tscn".
